metadata.description: HCG harness marketplace — two plugins: hcg-core (default, unhobbled methodology + Task-axis parallelism + 3 workflows) and hcg-harness (legacy pipeline harness, frozen at 0.2.x).

plugins.name: hcg-harness
plugins.description: HCG portable multi-agent development harness: 5 agent shells + 9 portable skills (pipeline-phase / codex-review / verification-ladder / contract-authoring / qa-e2e + db/backend/frontend HCG-stack conventions + ui-standard) + 4 hooks (PreToolUse contracts+destructive guard · PostToolUse lint · SessionStart context · Stop phase-gate) + 5 workflow templates (audit / migrate / test-gen / review / converge) + 3 commands (init · upgrade · qa, invoked /hcg-harness:init · :upgrade · :qa) backed by the scripts/bootstrap.mjs engine + the hcg stack profile + HARNESS core.

plugins.name: hcg-core
plugins.description: HCG unhobbled core (기본 권장): 슬림 방법론(Operating Rules §0–§5 + 작업 라우팅) + Task-축 병렬화(task-agent 1종 · parallel-tasks 스킬) + contracts 문서 규약 + HCG 스택 컨벤션 + codex-review 온디맨드 스킬(닫힌 트리거·백그라운드·게이트 아님) + 워크플로 3종(migrate · test-gen · converge) + SessionStart 훅 1종 + /hcg-core:init · :upgrade. 파이프라인이 필요한 프로젝트는 hcg-harness(레거시)를 설치 — 동시 설치 금지.
